note: Positive and defeating cases for contracts/verification-budget.json. The rule under test is decisions/0081 plus the #148/C0027 confirmation repair: a wall-clock reading records debt and never refuses, a check over its own ordinary ceiling is attributed and never refuses, and a pooled check past catastrophic_check_seconds is only a suspected catastrophe until an isolated re-reading confirms it. Times are inputs to the judge, not measurements of anything.

cases.proves: Every check inside its ceiling and a wall time inside the fastest band produces no debt, and the run says so rather than staying silent.
3.5s is seven times the 0.5s default and would be debt under it. The named 4.0s ceiling is what this check answers to.
A check added without a ceiling is not thereby exempt. The default applies and its overrun is attributed by name.

The defeating case for the old gate. 24.7s is a measured loaded-host reading that decisions/0050 would have failed outright. It earns no grade and records wall-clock debt; it produces no catastrophe and nothing here refuses.
The measured 2026-08-27 state. Both checks owe debt, both are named, and neither refuses the run - so a change to an unrelated fast check lands while the debt stays visible against its owner.

The hard ceiling still raises a catastrophe candidate. Confirmation decides whether it is an implementation regression or a crowded-host reading; without this case the table could quietly stop applying catastrophic pressure at all.
One pooled regression is represented once while it is being confirmed. If confirmation clears it, the demotion cases require its ordinary debt to return rather than disappear.

confirmation_cases.proves: A genuine pathological regression remains blocking: the check crossed the same 30-second ceiling after the shared pool was gone.

The #148/C0027 defect is defeated: pooled host contention alone cannot establish catastrophic implementation failure. The cleared overrun still returns as attributed performance debt instead of disappearing.
With confirmation required, the pooled reading is not sufficient evidence for refusal. The runtime must obtain an isolated reading before calling the implementation catastrophic.
